As far as I can remember, I saw one of my teachers saying to me that saying "Allahu Allahu", basically constant dhikr (like tasawwuf ones) is sinful and maybe she said that is the case if it done at home. Certain things happened afterwards in the dream but I cannot remember. Then my eyes opened and the mobile phone was still in my hand and I looked at the time to find that it was only about 20-25 mins after my eyes closed. This is the 2nd time dear respected one, that this has happened to me. The first time it was also after fajr and reading Qur'an and also lasted about the same time as the second one- although the content of the dream was different. Could you please explain? answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 46271 Country: India Title: Dream Question: My grandmother (Dadi) expired a week ago while she was reciting Kalimah. After 2-3 days of her burial my mother saw her in a dream that she is sitting wearing white clothes and there were other people around her and she is teaching the people about the things which shall take place after death. My mother noticed a lot of light (or Noor) there in her dream and said it was so much that I did wake up because my breath was stopping and it seemed I cannot bear the light (Noor). What is the interpretation of this dream? Answer ID: 46271 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1188/911/B=1434) Seeing your grandmother in white dress with extraordinary Noor indicates that she is in good condition i.e. peace and comfort. It shows that she has been forgiven and she is Jannati. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
